lines.text: Everything has a name.
A name is a promise... that something was here.
Sable! I wrote it! I wrote my name on the wall, just like you showed me!
[chuckle] Then the wall will remember you. Even when I'm old and forgetful.
Hush now.
Sable...?
Mira, take my hand! Don't let go. Don't let go!
No! Mira!
I don't remember her face anymore.
I remember that I swore.
The Storm Seed... it's gone!
The courier. Kaira was the last one in the vault. Find her!
[gasp] Okay. Okay. Framed, chased, and glowing. Great start to the week.
Courier! Return the Seed!
I don't HAVE it!
[sigh] Okay. I might have it.
Five days, courier. That's how long the elders give you before it tears you apart. Come quietly.
Quiet's not really my thing.
Hey! That was the GOOD crate!
Sorry! Not sorry! You should run.
Run from what?
Three grown-ups... against one girl?
Kid, that anchor hasn't moved in a hundred years
That's not very fair... for you.
Okay. Who ARE you?
Tamo! I work here. Well. I did, until you landed on me.
What is that?
Hollow. They took the lighthouse keeper last week. Nobody even remembers his name.
No... not here. Not the harbor.
The courier. And the anchor-bearer. Two of four.
[chuckle] The King will be so pleased.
Kaira! Whatever you've got, now would be a really good time!
I don't know how to use it!
Step away from them.
